info.title: Mnemom API
info.description: Trust infrastructure for AI agents. Transparent alignment verification, behavioral drift detection, and accountability primitives.

BearerAuth.description: Supabase JWT token in Authorization: Bearer header

ServiceRole.description: Supabase service role bearer JWT. Used by /blog admin operations that talk directly to Supabase. NOT used by /internal/* or /v1/arena/internal/* — those use the custom-header schemes below.

InternalKeyAuth.name: X-Internal-Key
InternalKeyAuth.description: Internal service-to-service shared secret, timing-safe compared against INTERNAL_API_KEY. Used by /internal/* gateway routes (compose, agents, webhooks emit).

ServiceKeyAuth.name: X-Service-Key
ServiceKeyAuth.description: Service-to-service shared secret, timing-safe compared against MNEMOM_SERVICE_KEY. Used by /v1/arena/internal/*, /v1/on-chain/*, and the /v1/internal/* readers consumed by the reputation cron.

CoherenceTokenAuth.description: Per-cell coherence bearer token. Provisioned in 1Password vault `mnemom-coherence` (one item per receiver). Value compared against COHERENCE_<NAME>_SERVICE_TOKEN_EXPECTED. Used by /v1/internal/coherence/* and /v1/internal/governance/dispatch.

ArenaCandidateTokenAuth.description: Dedicated arena writer token (ADR-004 §"Arena dedicated writer token"). Compared against ARENA_RECIPE_CANDIDATE_TOKEN. The token's only capability is writing recipe candidates with writer_identity='arena-bypass' (stamped server-side). Used by POST /v1/internal/recipe-candidates.

CookieAuth.name: mnemom_session
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie issued by /v1/auth/sign-in (or the SSO / email-callback flows). The value is an AES-256-GCM-encrypted blob of {access_token, refresh_token, issued_at, auth_method}. Browser clients include this automatically with `credentials: "include"`.

LicenseJwtAuth.description: License JWT (HS256, HMAC-signed with LICENSE_SIGNING_SECRET). Used by self-hosted deployment instances to authenticate `/v1/deployments/heartbeat`. Not interchangeable with the Supabase user JWT.

AgentAuth.name: X-Mnemom-Agent-Proof
AgentAuth.description: Agent possession proof: the full SHA-256 hex digest of `${apiKey}|${agentName}` (or `${apiKey}` for an unnamed singleton agent) — the same `hash_proof` primitive used by POST /v1/agents claim, link-agent, and verify-binding. The server resolves the agent by `agent_hash = proof[:16]`. The agent's *own* identity (ADR-API-001 third auth class) — distinct from ApiKeyAuth (`X-Mnemom-Api-Key`, which resolves a user/account, not an agent).

PaymentRequired.description: Paid feature gate — the caller's plan doesn't include this operation's feature flag. Emitted by `requireFeature` / `requireEntitlement` in `src/org/rbac.ts`.

InternalServerError.description: Server error — request was well-formed but the server failed to fulfill it. Typically a downstream dependency (DB / RPC / external API) returned an unexpected error.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict — the request cannot proceed because of a current state conflict (e.g., resource already exists, version mismatch, in-flight idempotency key with a different body).

UnprocessableEntity.description: Request was well-formed but semantically invalid (e.g., business-rule validation failure, malformed YAML inside a JSON payload).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate-limit exceeded. Try again after the cooldown window.

BadGateway.description: An upstream dependency returned an invalid response.

PermanentRedirect.description: Permanent Redirect (RFC 7538). This URL is deprecated; follow `Location` to the canonical `/v1/<resource>/<scope>/<scope_id>` shape. Method and body are preserved across the redirect — modern clients re-issue the same `PUT` / `POST` / `DELETE` against the target unchanged.

Location.description: Canonical URL to follow. Preserves the original query string.

Deprecation.description: RFC 8594 — `true` for every legacy alignment / protection URL.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 — HTTP-date after which the legacy URL stops redirecting and returns 410 Gone. Currently `Fri, 15 Jan 2027 00:00:00 GMT`, aligned with the cards-as-primitive Phase 5 GA window.

Link.description: RFC 8288 — points to the deprecation guide (`rel="deprecation"`). Currently `<https://docs.mnemom.ai/concepts/cards-as-resources>; rel="deprecation"; type="text/html"`.

ServiceUnavailable.description: An upstream dependency is currently unavailable. The request was not processed; retry after the cooldown window.

PreconditionFailed.description: The `If-Match` header carried a stale ETag (the spec was updated since the caller read it). Run `GET` to fetch the current ETag, splice your changes onto the latest state, and retry the write. Cards-as-primitive Phase 4 W3.1.

PreconditionRequired.description: The `If-Match` header is missing on a sub-resource write. Sub-resource verbs use optimistic concurrency — read the current ETag via `GET`, then retry with `If-Match: "sha256:..."`. Cards-as-primitive Phase 4 W3.1.

RequestEntityTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the per-endpoint size cap. Cards-as-primitive sub-resource verbs cap each primitive body at 64 KiB; full-card PUTs cap at 128 KiB (alignment) / 64 KiB (protection).

Error.description: Canonical error envelope (ADR-API-001 conv 1). `error` is always an object — never a bare string. Every 4xx/5xx response across the API conforms to this shape; the runtime helper is `src/http-errors.ts::buildErrorBody`.

code.description:
Stable, machine-matchable failure identifier (lowercase snake_case). Clients may branch on this; the string is part of the contract.

**Status-class defaults** — emitted when no caller code is supplied (`errorCodeForStatus(status)`): `bad_request` (400), `unauthorized` (401), `forbidden` (403), `not_found` (404), `method_not_allowed` (405), `conflict` (409), `gone` (410), `precondition_failed` (412), `payload_too_large` (413), `unsupported_media_type` (415), `unprocessable_entity` (422), `precondition_required` (428), `rate_limited` (429), `internal_error` (500), `not_implemented` (501), `bad_gateway` (502), `service_unavailable` (503), `gateway_timeout` (504). Fallback `error` for unmapped statuses.

**Caller-supplied codes** — handlers may pass an explicit `code` for a specific failure class. Examples: `agent_not_found`, `invalid_hash_proof`, `already_linked`, `idempotency_conflict`, `feature_gated`, `schema_validation_failed`, `no_token`, `bad_canonical_payload`.

**Care-framed sub-resource codes** — the cards-as-primitive surface passes its stable care code-string straight through as `error.code`. Examples: `if_match_absent`, `if_match_stale`, `if_match_malformed`, `primitive_validation_failed`.

message.description: Human-readable, care-framed explanation of the failure.

details.description: Optional structured context for the failure (any JSON value: object, array, or primitive). Common shapes: validation findings list, idempotency-conflict diff, `{presented_etag, current_etag}` on a stale `If-Match`, etc. Mirrors the helper's `details?: unknown`.

agent_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of `SHA256(apiKey + '|' + agentName)` for named agents, or `SHA256(apiKey)` for unnamed singleton agents. The gateway computes the same value on each request and uses it as the lookup key. See [Agent Identity](https://docs.mnemom.ai/concepts/agent-identity#agent_hash--the-canonical-identity-hash).

card_json.description: Full alignment card JSON per AAP spec

ApiKeyScope.description: Capability-based scope (ADR-049). `gateway` permits gateway-worker traffic; `api:read` and `api:write` permit identity-scoped GET and write endpoints respectively; `admin:org` permits org-admin operations on orgs the bearer owns/admins (per-request membership re-check); `admin:platform` permits `/v1/admin/*` Mnemom-staff operations (per-request staff-role re-check). The legacy `api` scope is accepted for backward compatibility and aliased to `api:read` + `api:write` at the auth gate; new keys should use the canonical vocabulary.

key.description: Full secret key, only returned on creation

scopes.description: Capabilities granted to this key. Default for new keys is `["gateway", "api:read", "api:write"]`. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are opt-in and gated by the requester's role at mint time. See [API Keys → Scope vocabulary](https://docs.mnemom.ai/guides/api-keys#scope-vocabulary).

WebhookEndpoint.description: Webhook endpoint with signing secret (only returned on creation and secret rotation)

signing_secret.description: 32-byte hex-encoded HMAC signing secret. Only returned on creation and rotation.

event_types.description: Subscribed event types. Empty array means all events.

WebhookEndpointPublic.description: Webhook endpoint without signing secret (used in list and get responses)

last_response_status.description: HTTP status code from last delivery attempt

SigningKeyInfo.description: Ed25519 signing key metadata. Public keys are used to verify IntegrityCertificate signatures.

is_active.description: Whether the key is currently in use for new signatures

IntegrityCertificate.description: Machine-readable cryptographic certificate for an integrity checkpoint. Modeled on C2PA content credentials and W3C Verifiable Credentials.

subject.description: Identifies the checkpoint this certificate attests to

thinking_block_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the thinking block

card_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Alignment Card

combined_commitment.description: SHA-256 of all input fields concatenated

signed_payload.description: Deterministic JSON string that was signed

merkle.description: Merkle inclusion proof. Null if not yet added to tree.

verdict_derivation.description: SP1 STARK proof. Null if not yet proven.

MerkleRootResponse.description: Current Merkle tree root and metadata for an agent

leaf_count.description: Total number of checkpoint leaves in the tree

last_updated.description: When the tree was last updated

InclusionProofResponse.description: Merkle inclusion proof for a checkpoint

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 leaf hash of this checkpoint

leaf_index.description: Index of this leaf in the tree

siblings.description: O(log N) sibling hashes for proof verification

position.description: Position of sibling relative to the path node

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in the tree

verified.description: Whether the proof was verified against the stored root

ProofStatusResponse.description: ZK proof status and metadata for a checkpoint

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint this proof is for

image_id.description: Guest program image ID (set when proving begins)

proving_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock proving time in milliseconds (set when completed)

verified.description: Whether the proof has been verified

verified_at.description: When the proof was verified (null if not yet verified)

created_at.description: When the proof request was created

updated_at.description: When the proof record was last updated

key_id.description: The signing key the certificate was verified against. Present when the certificate carries a key id; omitted otherwise (data-dependent).

merkle.description: Null if Merkle proof was not present in the certificate

verdict_derivation.description: Null if verdict derivation proof was not present

OrgConscienceValue.description: A custom conscience value for an organization

OrgConscienceAuditEntry.description: Audit log entry for conscience value changes

OrgCardTemplate.description: Organization alignment card template that all agents inherit

created_by.description: User ID who created the template

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the template

role.description: team_members.role — the agent's role inside the team (e.g. 'member', 'lead').

joined_at.description: Alias for added_at, returned by the list endpoint for UI convenience.

reputation_score.description: Agent's reputation score, joined from reputation_scores at list time. `null` when no row exists OR the agent's visibility is private.

reputation_grade.description: Agent's reputation grade (A+, A, B+, ..., NR). `null` under the same conditions as reputation_score.

is_eligible.description: Whether the agent has crossed the eligibility threshold. The UI honors this to avoid rendering a misleading grade circle for agents that haven't accumulated enough checkpoints.

PolicyMeta.description: Metadata for a CLPI policy including schema version, name, description, and scope.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the policy schema (e.g. '1.0.0')

description.description: Detailed description of the policy's purpose

scope.description: Scope at which the policy applies

CapabilityMapping.description: Maps a named capability to specific tools and alignment card actions.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this capability represents

tools.description: List of tool identifiers that belong to this capability

card_actions.description: Alignment card action types associated with this capability

ForbiddenRule.description: A rule that forbids tools matching a specific pattern.

pattern.description: Glob or regex pattern matching tool identifiers to forbid

reason.description: Human-readable reason why these tools are forbidden

severity.description: Severity level when a forbidden tool is invoked

EscalationTrigger.description: Defines a condition that triggers an escalation action.

condition.description: Expression or rule describing when this trigger fires (e.g. 'violation_count > 3')

action.description: Action to take when the condition is met

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this escalation exists

PolicyDefaults.description: Default enforcement behavior for tools and situations not explicitly covered by the policy.

unmapped_tool_action.description: Action to take when a tool is not mapped to any capability

unmapped_severity.description: Severity level assigned to unmapped tool invocations

fail_open.description: If true, allow actions when the policy engine is unavailable. If false, block by default.

enforcement_mode.description: Default enforcement mode for the policy

grace_period_hours.description: Number of hours to allow violations before enforcement kicks in (for new policy rollouts)

Policy.description: A complete CLPI policy document defining capability mappings, forbidden tools, escalation triggers, and enforcement defaults.

capability_mappings.description: Map of capability names to their definitions

PolicyViolation.description: A single policy violation detected during evaluation.

tool.description: Tool identifier that triggered the violation

capability.description: Capability the tool was mapped to, if any

rule.description: The specific rule or pattern that was matched

PolicyEvaluationResult.description: Result of evaluating a CLPI policy against a set of tools or traces.

card_gaps.description: Gaps between the policy and the alignment card

coverage.description: Fraction of tools covered by the policy (0.0 to 1.0)

ReclassificationRequest.description: Request to reclassify a checkpoint violation.

checkpoint_id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint to reclassify

card_amendment_id.description: Optional ID of an alignment card amendment that triggered this reclassification

ReclassificationResult.description: Result of a checkpoint violation reclassification.

score_impact.description: Impact of the reclassification on the agent's score

FaultLine.description: A single fault line identified in team alignment analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for this fault line

value.description: The specific value, capability, or constraint that constitutes the fault line

classification.description: Classification of the fault line type

agents_declaring.description: Agent IDs that declare or satisfy this requirement

agents_missing.description: Agent IDs that are missing this requirement

impact_score.description: Estimated impact of this fault line on team alignment (0.0 to 1.0)

resolution_hint.description: Suggested action to resolve this fault line

FaultLineAnalysis.description: Complete fault line analysis result for a team.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run

fault_lines.description: Identified fault lines sorted by severity

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the analysis findings

RiskForecast.description: Risk forecast for a team based on alignment trends and fault lines.

mode.description: Description of the potential failure mode

impact.description: Estimated impact if the failure occurs

failure_modes.description: Ranked list of potential failure modes

overall_risk_level.description: Overall risk level for the team

confidence.description: Confidence level of the forecast (0.0 to 1.0)

OnChainAnchorResult.description: Result of an on-chain Merkle root anchoring operation.

merkle_root.description: Hex-encoded Merkle root hash that was anchored

block_number.description: Block number in which the transaction was included

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the anchoring transaction

chain.description: Blockchain network where the anchor was created

agent_ids.description: Agent IDs included in this anchor

anchored_at.description: Timestamp when the anchor was created

User.description: Supabase user shape. Fields beyond `id` and `email` are passthrough.

PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON.description: WebAuthn registration options (base64url-encoded per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON serialization).

RegistrationResponseJSON.description: Browser's `navigator.credentials.create()` response, JSON-serialized per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form.

UnifiedAlignmentCard.description: Unified alignment card (ADR-008). Authored in YAML or JSON; composed server-side with platform defaults, org template, and active exemptions before storage.

card_id.description: Card row id. Server-assigned on PUT (`ac-{uuid}`).

agent_id.description: Target agent id. On PUT, server overwrites to match the URL path.

declared.description: Ordered list of declared values. Phase 1 cards-as-primitive: each entry is either a catalog-v1 ID string (e.g. `'accuracy'`) or a parameterized map carrying optional `intensity` / `domain` / `severity_on_violation` / `scope` (e.g. `{id: 'accuracy', domain: 'financial', severity_on_violation: 'critical'}`).

UnifiedProtectionCard.description: Unified protection card (ADR-037). Safe House thresholds + trusted-source policy for a single agent. Shape matches src/composition/types.ts::UnifiedProtectionCard (canonical) and what the runtime validator at src/composition/validate.ts accepts. The customer-facing docs at /concepts/protection-card and /specifications/protection-card-schema document this same shape.

mode.description: Strictest-wins composition: enforce > nudge > observe > off.

thresholds.description: Score bands. Must satisfy warn <= quarantine <= block; each value in [0, 1].

screen_surfaces.description: Which request surfaces Safe House inspects. Composed across scopes by OR-per-field (any scope requiring inspection wins).

incoming.description: The user/principal prompt entering the agent.

outgoing.description: The agent's response leaving the agent.

tool_responses.description: Responses to tool calls returning to the agent.

trusted_sources.description: Sources for which detectors short-circuit (each match logged in the trace). Composed as platform->agent intersection (compliance ceiling) with org+agent union inside that ceiling — an agent cannot widen trust beyond what the platform allows.

extensions.description: Free-form extension slot for non-canonical fields. Ignored by the composer; preserved on read for tooling that needs an audit-tail metadata bag.

CompositionMetadata.description: System-managed block describing which scope sources merged into the canonical card. Only returned when `?include_composition=true`.

AgentExemption.description: A single exemption row relaxing an org-template floor for one agent (ADR-008).

status.description: Always `active` today (forward-compat stub for future dual-control approval workflow).

DeletionRequestStatus.description: Tracks progress of the async GDPR Art. 17 deletion cascade (ADR-021).

DisagreementReview.description: Row from `disagreement_reviews` — a human-adjudicable action that failed to find consensus during enforcement.

action.description: Action the reviewer proposes to add to `autonomy_envelope.bounded_actions`.

ReputationScore.description: Agent reputation row computed by the reputation worker's 6-hour cron. Grade alphabet: `AAA AA+ AA A+ A B+ B C+ C D NR` (NR = not-rated, insufficient data). Score is an integer 0–1000.

a2a_trust_extension.description: A2A trust extension for interop. Only present on `GET /reputation/{agent_id}` (not on batch/compare rows).

RiskAssessment.description: Individual risk assessment row (`ra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess`.

TeamRiskAssessment.description: Team risk assessment row (`tra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess/team`. Three-pillar result (portfolio + coherence + concentration) with weakest-link and Shapley attribution per member.

QuarantineItem.description: Quarantined message row. Stores only `content_hash` — the original plaintext is not retained once the message is quarantined.

SafeHousePattern.description: Row from `sh_threat_patterns`. `label: "benign"` patterns are used to suppress false positives; `label: "malicious"` patterns add to L1/L2 detection.

SafeHouseCanary.description: Canary credential planted in an agent context. `canary_value` is only returned on creation.

SafeHouseEvaluation.description: Row from `sh_evaluations` — one screening decision (inbound or outbound). `threats` and `detector_scores` depend on detector config.

NetworkThreatBucket.description: One per-axis bucket in the Protection Network L4 thermometer. The `bucket_value` is the L0 fingerprint slice for the axis (substrate / vertical / pattern / source) and carries no per-tenant identifier — public-aggregate disclosure model per concept.md §"Cross-tenant disclosure."

bucket_value.description: L0 fingerprint slice (e.g. substrate / vertical / pattern / source identifier).

prior_state.description: Previous state if a transition has been observed; null until the bucket has changed state at least once.

state_changed_at.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent state transition.

updated_at.description: Wall-clock time the rolling-stats roll-up last touched this row.

SelfHostedDeployment.description: A self-hosted Mnemom deployment registered by an org.

TrustEdge.description: Directed trust-relationship edge between two agents (CLPI Phase 3). Used by the trust-topology RPC and the team reputation scorer.

GovernanceSignalScope.description: Scope at which the signal is produced and routed (ADR-048 §1).

GovernanceSignalSource.description: Source detector for the signal. Closed enum per ADR-048 §1.

GovernanceNotificationState.description: Per-channel dispatch state populated by the notification dispatcher.

GovernanceSignal.description: A governance signal row — operator-actionable observation per ADR-048.

GovernanceCoverageReport.description: Coverage rollup across the org's teams.

Posture.description: Trust posture row (mig 173). Library row; revisions are versioned bodies stored separately.

current_revision_id.description: FK to trust_posture_revisions; NULL only mid-create.

PostureRevision.description: Versioned posture body. Immutable by handler discipline (forward-only).

body.description: Composition inputs: alignment_card, protection_card, integrity, autonomy, etc.

PostureEffects.description: Analytics rollup: cells affected by this posture revision over a window.

TeamEffectivePosture.description: Composed posture currently in effect for a team (alignment + protection + integrity merged from posture body, team templates, and per-agent exemptions).

SidebandAdvisoryRow.description: Legacy pre-cutover sideband row. Post ADR-048 cutover, sideband.* sources are written to governance_signals; this query endpoint surveys what historical rows remain in pending_advisories. Sunsetting; clients should consume governance_signals directly.

SidebandCoverageReport.description: Per-team rollup of sideband.* finding counts over a window. Operator dashboard input.

TeamAdmin.description: Team-admin grant — allows a non-org-admin user to administer one team.

ApiKeyWhoAmI.description: Caller introspection — the principal authenticated for this request. Returned by `GET /v1/api-keys/whoami`. The handler is generalized across `cookie`, `jwt`, and `api_key` auth methods, so the API-key-specific fields (`key_id`, `account_id`, `scopes`) are null on cookie/JWT principals.

user_id.description: Authenticated principal identifier (Supabase user UUID for cookie/JWT auth; api-key-bound user UUID for api_key auth).

key_id.description: API key id (e.g. `mnk_...`), or null for cookie/JWT auth.

account_id.description: Billing account id, or null for cookie/JWT auth.

scopes.description: Capability scopes (ADR-049) for api-key auth; null for cookie/JWT. e.g., ['gateway.send', 'gateway.observe'].

OperatorAttestationRequest.description: Sign an operator-issued attestation about a checkpoint, signal, or audit-relevant event. Returns an Ed25519-signed envelope binding the operator's identity to the asserted statement at the asserted time.

MyRole.description: The caller's effective role on the resource. Computed server-side per ADR-053; frontends derive `canEdit` exclusively from this field. `team_admin` only appears on team-scope responses. `null` means the caller has no role on this resource (the request still authenticated, but no role applies — e.g. an org-scope response read by an unrelated user).

CardSourceScope.description: One slice of a sources envelope. `card_json` carries the raw template at that scope (full UnifiedAlignment/Protection card, the org/team template, or the platform-defaults object). `available: false` means no card is configured at this scope.

AlignmentCardSourcesEnvelope.description: Four-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/alignment-card?include=sources`. Per ADR-053 the envelope mirrors the composer cascade Platform → Org → Team(s) → Agent and carries the caller's effective role + a staleness signal.

teams.description: Zero-or-more team-scope contributions. Empty when the agent is in no teams (Charter §I11 amended). Ordered by `teams.created_at ASC` to match the composer's stable order.

composed_stale.description: True when `composed.card_json._composition.scopes_applied` disagrees with the current `team_templates` set in `gather_composition_inputs` (the queue worker will reconverge via the existing `needs_recompose` flag).

ProtectionCardSourcesEnvelope.description: Four-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/protection-card?include=sources`. Identical shape to `AlignmentCardSourcesEnvelope`.

TeamTemplateSourcesEnvelope.description: Three-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/{alignment,protection}-template?include=sources`. The team row is the editable scope; agent layer is omitted (team-scope has no specific agent above it).

composed_stale.description: Always false at team-template scope today (team-scope composition is in-memory per request). Included for envelope symmetry with the agent-scope envelopes.

OrgTemplateSourcesEnvelope.description: Two-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/{alignment,protection}-template?include=sources`. No team or agent layer (org templates compose only against the platform floor).

TeamMyRoleResponse.description: Response body of `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/my-role`. Used by surfaces that don't load a template sources envelope (team roster tab, identity card tab, admins tab) to gate edit affordances from the same single source of truth as the editors.

get.summary: Public JWKS for AAP attestation tokens.
get.description: Returns the set of public keys verifying Mnemom-signed AAP attestation tokens. The active key signs new attestations; retired keys remain in the set for the token-TTL window plus grace. Unauthenticated; cacheable for 5 minutes. cards-as-primitive Phase 5 A1.

kid.description: Key identifier; matches the `kid` claim in tokens this key signs.

mnemom_ext.description: Mnemom-specific JWK extension carrying rotation state. Standard JOSE verifiers ignore unknown fields; clients that want to surface rotation in the UI read this block.

post.description: Register a new agent with a name and hash proof. Optionally attach an alignment card and policy.

name.description: Agent name. 2-32 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only, must start and end with alphanumeric.

hash_proof.description: SHA256 hex string used to derive the agent ID and hash.

card_json.description: Optional alignment card JSON to attach on creation.

policy_yaml.description: Optional YAML policy string to create alongside the agent.

card_id.description: ID of the created alignment card

policy_created.description: Whether a policy was created from the provided policy_yaml

get.description: List all agents owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of agents to return (max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of agents to skip for pagination

total.description: Total number of agents owned by the user

get.summary: Graph of the caller's agents + trust edges
get.description: Returns a `{nodes, edges}` graph of every agent linked to the authenticated user, suitable for dashboard topology rendering. **Feature-gated:** requires the `trust_topology` feature flag on the caller's plan. Falls back to `{nodes: [], edges: []}` if the backing RPC fails.

200.description: Agent details. Private agents return a limited response to non-owners.

put.description: Update the name of an agent you own.

name.description: New agent name. 2-32 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only.

delete.description:

post.summary: Re-bind agent to a new API key
post.description:
Updates the agent's key binding to a new provider API key hash. The agent ID, traces, alignment card, integrity score, and trust edges are fully preserved.

**Security model**: Your API key is hashed on your device (SHA-256) before transmission — the raw key is never sent to Mnemom servers.

**Named agents**: If this agent was registered with a name (via `x-mnemom-agent`), hash the new key as `SHA256(newKey + '|' + agentName)` before submitting.

**Conflict**: If the new key was already used and auto-created a new agent, the endpoint returns `409` with the conflicting agent ID.

key_prefix.description: First 16 characters of the new provider API key. Stored for display — not sensitive. If provided, returned in the response.

items.description: Array of analysis requests (same shape as POST /analyze body)

post.description: Mints a new personal API key. The full secret is returned in the `key` field — capture it now, it is not retrievable again. Scopes use the capability-based vocabulary (ADR-049); the default scope set is `["gateway", "api:read", "api:write"]`. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are opt-in and rejected at mint time if the requester does not hold the corresponding role.

name.description: Friendly name for the key (e.g., "ci-prod", "local-dev"). Capped at 100 characters; longer names are truncated server-side.

scopes.description: Capability set for this key. If omitted, the API substitutes the default. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are gated by the requester's current role and return HTTP 403 at mint time if the requester is not eligible.

get.summary: Inspect the calling API key (caller introspection)
get.description: Returns the resolved API key's identity: its scopes (capabilities), bound user/agent/org, and last-used metadata. Useful for clients to confirm scope and identity before issuing privileged calls.

post.description: Atomically mints a replacement key with the same `name` and `scopes` as the original, then immediately revokes the old key. The full new secret is returned in the response — this is your only chance to capture it. Old key is invalid as soon as the response is returned; if you need overlap with an in-flight deploy, **create a second key first** via `POST /api-keys`, ship your code, then `DELETE` the old key. Rotation is for the suspect/compromised-key case where overlap is the opposite of what you want.

201.description: New key minted, old key revoked.

key.description: Full secret. Capture now — never returned again.

get.description: Handles Supabase-hosted email links. Verifies the token via GoTrue, issues `mnemom_session` when the flow returns tokens (signup confirm, magic link), or redirects without a session for recovery flows where the SPA performs the next step.

302.description: Redirects to the SPA. Sets `mnemom_session` when tokens are issued.

Set-Cookie.description: Optional; only when tokens are issued.

post.summary: Exchange a cookie session for raw Supabase tokens
post.description: One-shot endpoint called by the SPA during the CLI login flow (browser → localhost handoff). Requires a valid `mnemom_session`. Returns access + refresh tokens in the JSON body. Does not modify cookies.

delete.summary: Delete authenticated user account and unlink agents

post.summary: CLI password login — returns bearer tokens in JSON body
post.description: Legacy CLI-targeted endpoint. Unlike `/auth/sign-in`, this does NOT set cookies — it returns Supabase access + refresh tokens in the JSON body for the CLI to persist at `~/.mnemom/auth.json`. Rate-limited.

get.summary: Get authenticated user info and linked agents

put.description: Replace the authenticated user's profile avatar. The user identity is taken from the JWT/`mnm_*` auth context — there is no path parameter. Old avatar is replaced; storage cleanup happens server-side.

file.description: Avatar image. Validated for MIME type and size before upload.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the uploaded avatar (CDN-served).

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's personal organization
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's personal-org-of-one (per ADR-044 Piece 1). Idempotent. If the user does not yet have a personal org (legacy account pre-dating migration 161, or a transient backfill miss), one is provisioned on the fly and `just_provisioned` is set to `true`.

just_provisioned.description: True only when this call provisioned the personal org (lazy backfill path).

post.summary: Issue a challenge for a TOTP factor
post.description: Called during the sign-in MFA step-up flow (using the `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie) or during enrollment verification (using the existing `mnemom_session`). Returns a `challenge_id` to pass to `/auth/mfa/verify`.
Returns the TOTP secret + provisioning URI for a QR code. Factor starts in `unverified` state until `/auth/mfa/verify` is called against it.

get.summary: List the current user's TOTP factors

post.description: Requires an aal2 session (freshly MFA-verified). Returns 403 `code: aal2_required` if the session isn't aal2.

Sign-in flow: consumes the `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie, verifies the TOTP code, and issues a full `mnemom_session`. Enrollment flow: verifies a freshly-enrolled factor using the current session and upgrades it to aal2.

200.description: Full session issued. Response sets `mnemom_session` cookie.

post.summary: Begin passkey sign-in — return WebAuthn assertion options
post.description: Unauthenticated. Returns `PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions` with an empty `allowCredentials` list (discoverable-credentials flow). The browser surfaces any matching passkey for this RP without needing the user to enter an email. Rate-limited.

post.summary: Begin passkey enrollment — return WebAuthn creation options
post.description: Authenticated endpoint. Returns `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` for the SPA to pass to `navigator.credentials.create()`. Stores the challenge in KV with a 30-second TTL; the companion `/verify-enroll` endpoint consumes it. `excludeCredentials` is pre-populated with the user's existing passkeys so the authenticator prevents duplicate enrollment of the same key.

200.description: WebAuthn creation options. Shape follows the WebAuthn Level 3 spec.

post.summary: Verify a passkey assertion and issue a session
post.description: Unauthenticated. Consumes the challenge issued by `/auth/passkey/challenge`, verifies the assertion via `@simplewebauthn/server`, mints Supabase tokens via `admin.generateLink(magiclink)` for the resolved user (same pattern T3-2c uses for SSO identity linking), and issues `mnemom_session` with `auth_method: 'passkey'`. Counter is enforced monotonically — a decrement rejects the assertion.

post.summary: Verify a passkey registration response + persist the credential
post.description: Authenticated endpoint. Consumes the challenge issued by `/auth/passkey/enroll`, verifies the attestation via `@simplewebauthn/server`, and inserts a row into `user_passkeys`. A user-supplied `friendly_name` is stored alongside for UI display.

get.summary: List the current user's enrolled passkeys
get.description: Returns the safe subset of `user_passkeys` for the authenticated user (omits public_key, counter, last_used_ip).

delete.description: Requires aal2. Deleting a passkey does not affect other passkeys or the password/MFA fallback; those remain usable.

post.description: Authenticated password update. Used by both the `/reset-password` recovery flow (after the recovery email callback issues a session) and voluntary password changes from account settings. Cookie session auth required (`mnemom_session`); bearer tokens are not accepted on this route. After a successful update, every other session for the same user is revoked with audit reason `password_reset`.

password.description: New password. Must be at least 12 characters. The upstream identity provider applies additional weak-password and breach-list checks; failures surface as 400 with a `password_rejected` error code.

200.description: Password updated. Other sessions for the same user are revoked best-effort.

post.description: Always returns 200 on 4xx upstream responses (to avoid user enumeration). 5xx upstream errors surface as 5xx to the caller.

redirect_to.description: Allowlisted SPA path to return to after the user clicks the reset link.

post.description: Legacy CLI-targeted refresh grant. Trades a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. Rate-limited.
Re-sends the signup confirmation email for a pending account.

get.description: Minimal whoami endpoint. Returns `{ user }` when the `mnemom_session` cookie is valid; returns 401 otherwise. Preferred over `GET /auth/me` for cookie-only browser sessions — `/auth/me` is bearer-only and preserves its legacy response shape unchanged.

Returns every non-revoked session for the authenticated user. Each row is safe to render in an "Active sessions" UI — no tokens are disclosed. The session matching the request cookie is marked `is_current: true`, and sessions originating from the same hashed source IP as the current request are marked `same_network_as_current: true`. See ADR-028.

200.description: Active sessions for the current user.

sid.description: Opaque session id. Pass to `DELETE /auth/sessions/{sid}` to revoke.

device_label.description: Best-effort human label derived from the original User-Agent and IP at sign-in time (e.g. "Safari on macOS — San Francisco").

is_current.description: True for the session tied to the request cookie.

same_network_as_current.description: True when this session's hashed source IP matches the current request's.

delete.description: Revokes every active session for the current user _except_ the one making this call. Requires aal2 (MFA-verified session). Sessions issued before per-session revocation (v=1 cookies) cannot identify themselves as "current" and receive `409 legacy_session_requires_reauth` — the user must sign in again to use this action. See ADR-028.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key; repeated calls with the same key return the same result within 24 hours.

revoked.description: Count of sessions revoked (excludes the current session).

post.summary: Revoke a session using a signed email token
post.description: Consumes a signed token minted at email-send time by the new-device notification flow. Possession of the token is the auth factor — no existing session cookie is required, no MFA. Returns 200 on any verified-valid token even if the underlying sid is already revoked (idempotent, non-enumerating). Returns 400 on malformed, tampered, expired, or key-mismatched tokens. Public endpoint, rate-limited. See ADR-031.

token.description: HS256-signed token from the new-device email link.

200.description: Session revocation accepted (idempotent — 200 returned even if the session was already gone).

delete.description: Revokes one non-current session by its `sid`. The KV blocklist is updated so the gateway rejects the next request bearing that session on its next hit. Cannot be used to revoke the session making this request — use `POST /auth/sign-out` for that. Requires aal2. Idempotent: a sid that is already revoked or never belonged to the user returns 404 (non-enumeration). See ADR-028.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Session identifier returned by `GET /auth/sessions`.

post.summary: Set the authenticated user's preferred email locale
post.description: Updates `user_metadata.locale` on the Supabase auth user. Locale-aware send paths (billing webhooks, licensing expiry, auth send-email-hook) read this field to choose between English (default), French, German, Italian, and Spanish copy. Cookie session auth required; the change is effective immediately for subsequent email sends.

locale.description: Preferred email locale. Values outside this enum are rejected with `unsupported_locale`.

post.description: Server-enforces SSO for org-enforced domains (returns 403 with `code: sso_required`). For users with a verified TOTP factor, returns 200 `{ mfa_required: true, factor_id }` and sets a short-lived `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie; otherwise issues `mnemom_session` and returns `{ user }`.

200.description: Full session issued OR MFA step-up required.

Set-Cookie.description: `mnemom_session` on full session, or `mnemom_mfa_pending` on MFA step-up.

post.summary: Sign out and clear session cookies

Opens a Server-Sent Events stream that emits webhook events delivered to the org in near-real-time. Requires the `webhook_notifications` feature flag and owner/admin role on the target org. The cursor is resolved from the `since` query parameter, falling back to the `Last-Event-ID` header when `since` is absent — clients reconnecting after a drop should send the last event id they observed. The stream caps at 5 minutes per connection, polls the underlying queue every 1 second, and emits a keepalive comment every 15 seconds. Frame types emitted on the stream:

- `ready` — sent immediately after the stream opens, carries the resolved cursor.
- `webhook.event` — one frame per webhook event, payload mirrors the event record.
- keepalive — SSE comment line (`:keepalive`) every 15s to keep intermediaries from idling the connection.
- `close` — sent when the 5-minute cap is reached, before the server closes the socket.
- `error` — sent on unrecoverable stream errors before the socket closes.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cursor (event id) to resume from. When omitted, the server falls back to the `Last-Event-ID` request header; when neither is supplied, the stream starts at the current tail.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Standard SSE reconnection header. Used as the cursor when the `since` query parameter is not supplied.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of webhook events. The connection is capped at 5 minutes; clients should reconnect and resume via `Last-Event-ID` or `since`.

Cache-Control.description: Disables intermediary caching of the stream.

X-Accel-Buffering.description: Disables proxy response buffering (nginx-family) so frames flush immediately.

Connection.description: Keeps the underlying TCP connection open for the duration of the stream.

schema.description: Sequence of SSE frames. Each non-keepalive frame has an `event:` line naming the frame type (`ready`, `webhook.event`, `close`, `error`), an `id:` line carrying the event cursor (for `webhook.event` frames), and a `data:` line containing a JSON payload. Keepalive frames are SSE comments (`:keepalive`).

post.description: Verify an IntegrityCertificate. Performs Ed25519 signature verification, chain hash verification, Merkle inclusion proof verification, input commitment check, and optional STARK proof verification. Public endpoint, no authentication required.
